single.rationale: UniFirst shows solid free cash flow generation and improving margins, but faces significant headwinds including near-zero revenue growth in FY2025 (0.2%), intense competitive pressures from larger players like Cintas and Vestis, and multiple cost pressures (labor, healthcare, fuel). The business has stabilized operationally with improving OCF, but lacks growth catalysts and trades at reasonable but not compelling multiples (22x P/E, 4.3% FCF yield).

team.thesis: UniFirst has stabilized revenue at $2.4B after growing from $2.0B in FY 2022, but growth has stalled completely with 0.2% year-over-year growth in FY 2025 versus a prior three-year CAGR of 6.7%, while operating margins of 7.6% and net margins of 6.1% remain thin for a business with 91.2% revenue concentration in a segment directly tied to customer employment levels, facing structural cost pressure
